title: SB400 (2026 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2026/bills/SB400_.HTM; sha256 6718bce66d239ccbb6147422a411768970295bbbbd9570f84d5d9bd03be92bb1)
provenance.note: Introduced text (as filed). Version read is the bill as introduced; no passage vote is recorded. SECTION 2 (c) is quoted with the words the bill strikes (the in-State and fifteen-day/seventy-five-day lending language) left out; the bill strikes the authority to lend a rifle or shotgun without a permit and to lend one for use outside the State.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): Any lawfully acquired rifle or shotgun may be lent to an adult who is twenty-one years of age or older for use for a period not to exceed twelve hours; provided that the adult borrowing a rifle or shotgun possesses a permit pursuant to section 134-2 or owns or possesses a firearm that is registered pursuant to section 134-3, and is not prohibited from ownership or possession of a firearm pursuant to section 134-7.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): No person shall intentionally, knowingly, or recklessly lend a firearm to any person who does not have a permit pursuant to section 134-2, does not own or possess a firearm that is registered pursuant to section 134-3, or is prohibited from ownership, possession, or control of a firearm under section 134-7.
